'''S-R6''', also known as '''Essar''', was an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. For each of his missions, he had his central [[Programmer/Legends|programming]] and circuits transferred to a different [[Droid/Legends|droid]] shell for the purposes of disguise. S-R6 developed an enthusiasm for firearms, which affected his personality traits, and came to own a private collection of [[Blaster/Legends|guns]] from throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. He also employed a [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[T-3PO (S-R6)|T-3PO]], as a [[valet]] and go-between.

At some point, an [[Trevura droid resistance|underground droid enclave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trevura]] hired S-R6 to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Trevura's [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Merno Blask]]. In response, the governor arranged for Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to field-test experimental [[Inhibit setting|anti-droid]] [[DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] in the streets of [[Voma]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on Trevura. A group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents also present in Voma eventually fought and [["Inhibitor incident"|killed]] two of the stormtroopers carrying the inhibitor [[Blaster rifle/Legends|guns]]. Shortly after the [[Lightfight|firefight]], the Rebels came into contact with S-R6, who was masquerading as an [[ASP-series labor droid/Legends|ASP-series labor droid]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]]. When the group visited the [[Essar's garage|garage]] the assassin droid was using as a hideout, S-R6 expressed his eager interest in the dead [[Trooper/Legends|troopers']] inhibitor guns. The garage was then attacked by another group of stormtroopers, and after S-R6, T-3PO, and the Rebels defeated the Imperials, the assassin droid escaped his hideout with the pair of the inhibitor guns.

==Biography==
===Mission to Trevura===
S-R6, also known as Essar, was an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He invested in a [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]], [[T-3PO (S-R6)|T-3PO]], to act as his [[valet]] and go-between, and, due to the dangers involved in his profession, armed the [[Protocol droid/Legends|droid]] with a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] and [[Programmer/Legends|programmed]] him in its use, eventually coming to think of T-3PO as a useful ally.<ref name="Wizards" />

[[File:Dulin-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|250px|S-R6 was hired to assassinate the Imperial governor of Trevura.]]
At some point between [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Gun Nut]]" is set in the [[Rebellion era]], which {{Blog|holocron|24|Star Wars Eras}} places between [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> an [[Trevura droid resistance|underground droid enclave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trevura]] hired S-R6, who arrived from off-world, to [[Assassin/Legends|kill]] the local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Merno Blask]]. The assassin [[Droid/Legends|droid]] subsequently established a hideout in a [[Essar's garage|landspeeder garage]] in Trevura's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Voma]]. When Blask learned that a droid would attempt to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him, the governor was afraid that it would be a high-level assassin like [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88]]. In response, Blask arranged for an Imperial research-and-development team to carry out a field test of the [[inhibit setting]], a recently developed [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] mode of operation designed to disable droids, in Voma.<ref name="Wizards" />

As part of the test, Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were equipped with [[DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] outfitted with the inhibitor setting. On a [[Standard day/Legends|day]] before S-R6 planned to assassinate Blask, stormtroopers patrolled the city's streets, [[Ion blaster/Legends|ionizing]] any nearby droids under the pretense of the latter having gone rogue. Meanwhile, a [[Espionage droid|spy eye droid]] employed by S-R6 observed the Imperial activities.<ref name="Wizards" />

===Meeting Rebel agents===
{{RPG|"[[Gun Nut]]"}}
====A collector's interest====
By the same [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had dispatched a group of individuals to Trevura. The Rebel agents were to safely escort an [[Unidentified astromech droid (Trevura)|astromech droid]] carrying sensitive information about Imperial weapons research off the planet. In Voma, a pair of stormtroopers attempted to disable and search the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], leading to a short [["Inhibitor incident"|firefight]] in which the group killed the two [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. After the skirmish, S-R6's [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Eye/Legends|eye]] droid, which had witnessed the incident, flew away to report to its master.<ref name="Wizards" />

[[File:StormtrooperGunTrevura.jpg|thumb|right|200px|S-R6 became interested in obtaining experimental blaster rifles field-tested by Imperial stormtroopers.]]
Shortly thereafter, the Rebel agents came into contact with S-R6, who was masquerading as an [[ASP-series labor droid/Legends|ASP-series labor droid]], and visited the assassin's garage. There, the droid dropped his pretense and expressed his eager interest in the inhibitor guns. In response to the Rebels' inquiries, S-R6 very patiently revealed nearly everything regarding his assignment on Trevura but constantly kept bringing the conversation back to the inhibitor guns.<ref name="Wizards" />

====Garage firefight====
Eventually, a group of stormtroopers that had been summoned by the Imperial [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] observing the testing of the inhibitor weapons attacked the garage. An intense [[Lightfight|firefight]] ensued, with S-R6 leading the Rebel group and T-3PO by tossing [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenades]] at the Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], two of whom concentrated their fire at the wildly dangerous assassin droid. The droid and his allies emerged victorious, and S-R6 quickly thanked the Rebel agents for their help and then escaped with the inhibitor guns while the Rebels expeditiously took the astromech droid off-planet aboard their [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="Wizards" />

The group of Rebel agents encountered S-R6 again on several further occasions, during each of which the assassin was undercover in a new droid shell and on a mission to either eliminate a target or add a new gun to his collection. During each such meeting, S-R6 remembered the "inhibitor incident" on Trevura, and when the Rebels attempted to convince the droid to join the Alliance, he was willing to do so, albeit only because it would provide him with opportunities to travel and obtain new firearms.<ref name="Wizards" />
{{Endgame}}

==Characteristics==
===A cordial assassin===
As an assassin droid, S-R6 was proficient in the use of such weapons as [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]], [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]], and assorted heavy, simple, and vehicle-mounted weaponry, as well as light, medium, and heavy [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. In combat, the droid could perform skilled shots at point blank distance. S-R6 also possessed a variety of skills less directly related to his trade, such as gun craftsmanship and [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]], was very proficient in repairing technology and using explosives, and had extensive knowledge of munitions. S-R6 was also skilled in the use of [[Computer/Legends|computers]] and was able to program the protocol droid T-3PO to use a hold-out blaster, although the latter droid was not a very good shot. The droid could also read, [[Writing/Legends|write]], and [[Language/Legends|speak]] [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="Wizards" />

Despite his violent profession, S-R6 had a friendly&mdash;even cordial&mdash;personality. Following the "inhibitor incident" on Trevura, he regularly recalled with fondness the Rebel agents he had encountered during that event. However, although during the fighting in his garage S-R6 attempted to avoid catching the Rebels in the blast of his stun [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], he was eager to down his opponents and did not sacrifice a good shot for his allies' benefit. Furthermore, the droid felt determined to both kill the bigoted Governor Blask and destroy his [[Anti-droid sentiment/Legends|anti-droid prejudices]].<ref name="Wizards" />

===Collector in disguise===
[[File:ASPlabordroid-NEGTD.png|thumb|left|200px|During the mission on Trevura, S-R6 adopted the shell of an ASP-series labor droid (pictured).]]
At some point, S-R6 became overly enthusiastic about guns, to the point that his behavior became affected and he began using only gun-related metaphors in his speech, with even casual conversation with him sounding threatening as a result. The droid became a connoisseur and avid [[Collector/Legends|collector]] of various firearms from around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], constantly seeking to add new or exotic weapons to his private collection. He was very interested in acquiring prototype Imperial weapons, with his interest as both a professional and collector being peaked by the inhibitor guns on Trevura. In addition to the information on the inhibitor weapons he gained from his spy droid, S-R6 was also interested in learning about the various experiences related to the firearms' use, such as the feeling one had when hit by a blast from the gun, or how a [[Human/Legends|Human]] would hold one of the weapons.<ref name="Wizards" />

In order to ensure anonymity, for each mission S-R6 had his central programming and circuits transferred to a different droid shell. For the mission on Trevura, he adopted the look of a battered ASP-series [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]]. During that time, S-R6 was equipped with a [[Heuristic processor/Legends|heuristic processor]] and a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] and had [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] vision and locked access capabilities. Due to his ability to see in the dark, S-R6 once forgot that organic beings frequently needed light to see. As part of his labor droid disguise, S-R6 pretended to be very stupid and only communicated in public by using the words "affirmative" and "negative." In the privacy of his garage, however, the assassin droid communicated via surprisingly fluent speech.<ref name="Wizards" />

==Equipment==
During the "inhibitor incident," S-R6 carried two guns, one of which was a standard blaster [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]], and six stun grenades. The droid concealed all of the weapons on his body, allowing him to appear unarmed. The droid was expecting to be more heavily equipped on the day he would attempt to assassinate his target, Governor Blask. While on Trevura, S-R6 also employed the protocol droid T-3PO as well as a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|hovering]] spy eye droid similar to a [[M-TD miniaturized translator droid]].<ref name="Wizards" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Please, enter the chamber. I understand you've caused some stormtroopers to miss their mark today. Good shooting. I'd like to be the first to congratulate you.|S-R6 addresses the player characters in one of the possible scenarios in "Gun Nut"|<ref name="Wizards" />}}
S-R6 was created for "[[Gun Nut]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] mini-adventure for the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Jeff Quick]] and published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[April 11]], [[2002]]. "Gun Nut" presents two possible scenarios of events that depend on the player characters' actions concerning the two inhibitor guns of the stormtroopers they kill in the streets of Voma. If the characters pick up the weapons, S-R6 instructs his protocol droid go-between, T-3PO, to approach them and offer 600 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for both weapons. If the characters agree to the deal, T-3PO leads them to S-R6's garage, where the assassin droid greets the characters and personally continues the negotiation for the weapons.<ref name="Wizards" />

If the characters do not pick up the inhibitor guns, they are then collected by S-R6 in the disguise of a labor droid performing cleanup on behalf of the [[Trevura government]]. The "labor droid" then beckons for the characters to follow to his garage, upon which they can either choose to ignore the droid and quickly make preparations to leave the planet or follow him to his hideout, where S-R6 proceeds to question the characters about their experience with the inhibitor guns. Regardless of which scenario the player characters follow, they end up in S-R6's garage, proceeding to the remaining part of the adventure. This article assumes the adventure plays out as described.<ref name="Wizards" />
